definitions.explanation: An object that someone has found lying on the ground or left behind. Used for items found by chance.
Something unexpectedly good that one comes across by luck. Used figuratively for bargains, surprisingly talented people, or fortunate discoveries.

examples.japanese: {拾|ひろ}い{物|もの}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{交番|こうばん}→交番：02879_kouban⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}けよう→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧。
examples.english: Let's turn in found items at the police box.

examples.japanese: ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{拾|ひろ}い{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦したら→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}ける→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: If you find something on the street, you have an obligation to report it to the police.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{財布|さいふ}→財布：00663_saifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{拾|ひろ}い{物|もの}です⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}→持ち主：10439_mochinushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}しています→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: This wallet was found, so we are looking for its owner.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{拾|ひろ}い{物|もの}だった。
examples.english: This sale was a real find.

examples.japanese: ⟦{無名|むめい}→無名：13420_mumei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧だった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦シーズン→シーズン：10944_shiizun⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{拾|ひろ}い{物|もの}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}える→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}→活躍：02541_katsuyaku⟧だ。
examples.english: He was an unknown player, but his performance this season can be called a real find.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古本屋|ふるほんや}→古本屋：16329_furuhonya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見|み}つけた→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧{初版本|しょはんぼん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{思|おも}いがけない{拾|ひろ}い{物|もの}だった。
examples.english: The first edition I found at the used bookstore was an unexpected windfall.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 (literal found object) is common in everyday and legal contexts. Japan has a strong culture of turning in found items, and {拾|ひろ}い{物|もの} is the standard term used at police boxes and lost-and-found offices.

Sense 2 (figurative windfall) is commonly used in sports, shopping, and entertainment contexts to describe surprisingly good discoveries.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {拾|ひろ}い{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (find/pick up something)
- {拾|ひろ}い{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{届|とど}ける→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧ (turn in a found item)
- ⟦{思|おも}わぬ→思う：00492_omou⟧{拾|ひろ}い{物|もの} (unexpected find)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{落|お}とし{物|もの}→落とし物：08450_otoshimono⟧: lost item — the perspective of the person who lost it
- ⟦{掘|ほ}り{出|だ}し{物|もの}→掘り出し物：14746_horidashimono⟧: bargain, treasure find — specifically a valuable item found at a low price
